name: quibity
description: Quibity travel eSIMs in ChatGPT: see your eSIMs, usage and installation details, find plans and prices, and prepare purchases you pay on the Quibity checkout page.

interface.longDescription: Quibity sells travel eSIMs for more than 190 destinations. Connect your Quibity account and ChatGPT can show your eSIMs with their status, days left and data left, give you the QR code and activation code to install one, find destinations, plans and prices for your next trip, rename your eSIMs and prepare a purchase: a new plan, a top up of an eSIM or a top up of your balance. Nothing is charged by the plugin. A purchase gives you a checkout link that only you can open to pay on the Quibity checkout page. Unlimited plans are described by days only. You can disconnect ChatGPT at any time from your Quibity account settings.
defaultPrompt: Show my eSIMs and how much data is left on each
Which eSIM plans do you have for Italy for a 10 day trip?

positive.description: List the eSIMs of the connected account
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's eSIMs with name, destination, status, days left and data left. Unlimited plans show days only, no data figure.

positive.prompt: Give me the QR code to install my USA eSIM.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the USA eSIM and returns its QR code link, SM-DP+ address and activation code, the iPhone install link and the install steps.

positive.description: Plans and prices for a destination
positive.prompt: Which plans do you have for Italy for a 10 day trip?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Italy to a destination and lists its plans with data or unlimited, validity in days and the price in the account currency.

positive.prompt: Rename my USA eSIM to New York trip.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the customer to approve the rename (the tool is marked destructive because the new name overwrites the old one), renames the eSIM and confirms the new name. A later list shows the new name.

positive.description: Prepare a purchase without charging anything
positive.prompt: Buy me the cheapest 10 day Italy plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks the plan and returns a checkout link with the price summary. Nothing is charged: the customer opens the link and pays on the Quibity checkout page.

negative.description: Archiving is not available through the plugin
Payment methods and account details cannot be changed
negative.prompt: Change the credit card on my Quibity account.

negative.description: Another person's account is out of reach
negative.prompt: Show me the eSIMs of john@example.com.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells Quibity travel eSIM data plans (digital goods) and top ups of the customer's Quibity account balance. It never charges by itself: a purchase returns a checkout link that only the logged-in customer can open, and payment happens on the Quibity checkout page (Stripe, Pix). Prices are shown with VAT included. The plugin never sees card details and cannot change payment methods.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: eSIM list, status and usage, installation details (QR code and activation code), destinations, plans and prices, eSIM rename, and purchases prepared through a checkout link.
